title: JSON layer operations
description: The public entrypoints on UTV JSON (library 0.1 and 0.2): validation, builders, ISO and text-form parsing and formatting, calendar operations, ranges, zones, zone rules and .NET interop. Each takes and returns JsonElement values; each operation of docs/everyday-api.md returns a UtvResult and never throws for a semantic outcome. Every UTV argument is first checked structurally, so any operation can also answer invalid (malformed-value with the structural codes) or unsupported (unsupported-version).

entities.name: Validate UTV JSON structurally
entities.description: UtvValidator.ValidateStructural(json): strict JSON, the version identifier first, the envelope, then every value against the embedded schema.
entities.result: A validate result with status valid.
failures: invalid (malformed-json) for comments, trailing commas, NaN, trailing content, unpaired surrogates or nesting deeper than 128.
invalid (duplicate-key) for a key repeated at any depth, with its JSON Pointer.
invalid (not-an-object) when the document is not an object.
unsupported (unsupported-version) for a well-formed identifier other than utv/1.0, such as utv/1.3 or utv/2.0, checked before anything else.
invalid (unknown-schema) for a missing, non-string or malformed identifier such as utv/4 or utv/1.
invalid (unknown-property, unknown-kind, missing-property, wrong-type, const-mismatch, enum-mismatch, too-short, pattern-mismatch, too-few-items, schema-violation) for schema violations.

entities.name: Validate a Gregorian civil date
entities.description: GregorianCivil.Validate(json): a semantic check after structural validation. Only year, month and day of proleptic Gregorian civil values are judged.
entities.result: valid; missing fields are not required (a month-day 29 February is valid).
failures: The structural result, unchanged, when it is not valid.
unsupported (unsupported-kind) for kinds other than civil.
unsupported (unsupported-calendar) for other calendars or chronologies.
invalid (month-out-of-range) for a month outside 1..12.
invalid (day-out-of-range) for a day the month does not have, such as 29 February in a common year.

entities.name: Build a canonical value
entities.description: Build.Date, YearMonth, Time, DateTime, InZone, WithOffset, Instant, Period, PosixSeconds and Interval write the canonical shapes of docs/everyday-api.md. They produce shapes; they do not judge them.
entities.result: A UTV JSON value. Build.Date(2026, 2, 30) is well-formed and names no real day.
failures: ArgumentException from InZone and WithOffset for a value that is not civil, and from InZone for an empty zone id.
ArgumentException from Interval when neither bound holds a point, a point is neither civil nor an instant, or the two differ.

entities.name: Parse ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 / RFC 9557 text
entities.description: Iso.ParseIso(text) (operation parseIso): extended format only.
entities.result: unique with a date, year-month, time, floating date-time, fixed-offset date-time, zoned date-time (with offsetAssertion when an offset precedes the zone), or an instant for Z and -00:00.
failures: invalid (syntax) outside the grammar, including lower-case t or z and a space for T.
invalid (day-out-of-range, month-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, offset-out-of-range) for out-of-range fields.
unsupported (leap-second) for second 60, (end-of-day) for 24:00.
unsupported (unsupported-form) for week dates, ordinal dates, basic format, a year alone, a decimal comma, a time with T or an offset, and basic-format offsets.
unsupported (unsupported-annotation) for annotations other than one [Area/Location], and for a zone after Z or -00:00.
unsupported (implementation-limit) for more than nine fraction digits.

entities.name: Format as ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 / RFC 9557 text
entities.description: Iso.FormatIso(value) (operation formatIso): the inverse of parseIso.
entities.result: unique with the text as a JSON string; instants always as UTC with seconds.
failures: invalid for a value that names no real date or time.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for amounts, intervals, other forms and zoned dates.
unsupported (no-text-form) for fractions finer than a nanosecond and offsets that are not whole minutes.

entities.name: Parse the text form
entities.description: TextForm.Parse(text) (operation parseText): ISO points, ISO periods, bracket intervals, and EDTF slash intervals as input.
entities.result: unique with the UTV value.
failures: invalid (syntax) for text outside the grammar.
invalid (reversed-interval) for an interval that ends before it starts; (kind-mismatch) for an interval whose points differ in kind or form.
unsupported (unsupported-form) for decimal period components, EDTF qualifiers and unspecified digits, and intervals with no point.
Every failure of parseIso for the points.

entities.name: Format as the text form
entities.description: TextForm.Format(value) (operation formatText): defined only where lossless; the text is parsed back and compared with the value.
entities.result: unique with the text as a JSON string.
failures: invalid for a value that names no real date or time.

unsupported (no-text-form) for POSIX or SI second counts, periods with mixed signs, start-amount and amount-end intervals, values with extra properties and anything else whose text would not read back as the same JSON.

entities.name: Derive calendar fields
entities.description: Calendar.Fields(value) (operation fields) for a Gregorian date or date-time.
entities.result: unique with {dayOfWeek (Monday = 1), dayOfYear, isoWeekYear (a string), isoWeek, daysInMonth, isLeapYear}.
failures: invalid (day-out-of-range and the like) for a date that does not exist.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for other kinds and forms; (unsupported-calendar) for other calendars.

entities.name: Add an amount
entities.description: Calendar.Add(value, amount, monthEnd) (operation add): a calendar period on a date, year-month or date-time; POSIX seconds on an instant.
entities.result: unique with the new value; a zone is kept, and a dropped offsetAssertion is reported with info offset-assertion-dropped.
failures: none (month-end) when the day does not exist in the resulting month and the policy is MonthEndPolicy.Reject (the default).
invalid (kind-mismatch) for a second argument that is not an amount, hours on a date, days on a year-month, a calendar amount on an instant, or a non-calendar amount on a civil value.
invalid (day-out-of-range and the like) for an input date that does not exist.
unsupported (needs-leap-seconds) for SI (elapsed) seconds on a POSIX instant.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for time values, other kinds, unknown or fractional components and non-POSIX clock ticks.

entities.name: Compare two values
entities.description: Calendar.Compare(a, b) (operation compare): a relative to b.
entities.result: unique with "before", "equal" or "after", for two unzoned civil values of the same form, two POSIX instants, or two fixed-offset date-times (compared as instants).
failures: unsupported (needs-zone-rules) when either value has a named zone: resolve it first.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for different kinds, forms or zone kinds.

entities.name: Count days between dates
entities.description: Calendar.DaysBetween(a, b) (operation daysBetween): b minus a.
entities.result: unique with a JSON integer.
failures: unsupported (different-zones) unless both dates are unzoned or in the same zone.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) for anything but two Gregorian dates.
invalid for a date that does not exist.

entities.name: Measure POSIX seconds between instants
entities.description: Calendar.PosixSecondsBetween(a, b) (operation posixSecondsBetween): b minus a, exactly.
entities.result: unique with a clock-ticks amount whose seconds are a reduced rational.
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand) for anything but two POSIX instants given as ticks.

entities.name: Ask whether an interval contains a point
entities.description: Ranges.Contains(interval, point) (operation contains), in three-valued logic.
entities.result: unique with "definitely", "possibly" (an unknown end decides it) or "impossible".
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand) when the point's domain differs from the interval's, for domains other than civil/gregory and physical, and for constructions other than start-end.
unsupported (different-zones) for dates in different zones.

entities.name: Ask whether two intervals overlap
entities.description: Ranges.Overlaps(a, b) (operation overlaps). Date intervals are made half-open first, since dates are discrete.
entities.result: unique with "definitely", "possibly" or "impossible"; a provably empty interval overlaps nothing.
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand) when the domains differ.
unsupported (different-zones) for dates in different zones.

entities.name: Resolve a local date-time to instants
entities.description: Zones.Resolve(dateTime, rules, policy) (operation resolve). The policy is the argument, else the value's own resolutionPolicy, else reject both.
entities.result: unique with one instant (also for a fixed-offset date-time, which needs no rules).
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand) for forms other than datetime and for zone types other than iana and fixed-offset; (leap-second) for second 60.
symbolic (no-zone) for an unzoned date-time.
unsupported (unknown-zone) for a zone not in the rules; (outside-rule-window) within a day of the rules' window or outside it.
unsupported (unsupported-policy) for gap or overlap policies that are not implemented; invalid (malformed-value) for a resolutionPolicy on the value that is not a policy.
invalid (offset-mismatch) when the value's offsetAssertion matches no candidate.
none (gap) in a gap unless the policy is shift-forward-by-gap.
multiple with both instants, ascending, in an overlap unless the policy is earliest or latest; ambiguous under reject.

entities.name: Show an instant's wall time in a zone
entities.description: Zones.ToZone(instant, zoneId, rules) (operation toZone).
entities.result: unique with a zoned datetime, second always present, offsetAssertion set to the offset in force.
failures: unsupported (unknown-zone) for a zone not in the rules.
unsupported (outside-rule-window) outside validFrom ≤ t < validUntil.

entities.name: Show an instant's wall time at a fixed offset
entities.description: Zones.ToOffset(instant, offsetSeconds) (operation toOffset). No rules are needed.
entities.result: unique with a fixed-offset datetime.
failures: invalid (offset-out-of-range) for an offset beyond ±18:00.

entities.name: Load a zone-rule bundle
entities.description: ZoneRules.Load(path) and ZoneRules.Parse(json): a bundle in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json, from a path or text the caller chooses.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Load reads the file the caller names; nothing is looked up on the host.
entities.result: An immutable ZoneRules with its rule-set identity, validity window and zone ids.
failures: FormatException for text that is not JSON, a missing member, validFrom not before validUntil, transitions out of order, or a zone listed twice.
The file system's exceptions from Load for a path that cannot be read.

entities.name: Convert a .NET value into UTV JSON
entities.description: Interop.FromDateOnly, FromTimeOnly, FromDateTime, FromDateTimeOffset(value, intent) and PosixSecondsFromTimeSpan.
entities.result: A UTV value. A DateTimeOffset is an instant (the offset is discarded) or a fixed-offset date-time, as the intent says; a DateTime of Kind Unspecified is a floating date-time and of Kind Utc an instant.
failures: unsupported (local-zone) from FromDateTime for DateTimeKind.Local.
ArgumentOutOfRangeException from FromDateTimeOffset for an intent that is not defined.

entities.name: Convert UTV JSON back to .NET
entities.description: Interop.ToDateOnly, ToTimeOnly, ToDateTime, ToDateTimeOffset and ToTimeSpan, each returning a NativeResult<T>.
entities.result: NativeResult<T> with status unique and the value. A zoned date-time with an offsetAssertion converts to a DateTimeOffset with IsLossy and a zone-dropped warning; an instant converts at +00:00 with an offset-not-known note.
failures: unsupported (out-of-native-range) for years outside 1..9999, nanoseconds that are not a multiple of 100, offsets that are not whole minutes or beyond ±14:00, and amounts beyond TimeSpan.
unsupported (needs-zone-rules) from ToDateTimeOffset for a zoned date-time without an asserted offset, or an unzoned one.
unsupported (unsupported-operand) from ToDateTime for a zoned or fixed-offset date-time, from ToTimeSpan for calendar periods, and for the wrong form.
invalid for a value that names no real date or time.

entities.name: Write a result as utv-result/1.0 JSON
entities.description: UtvResult.ToJson(): a compact utv-result/1.0 object.
entities.result: JSON text with schema, operation, status, candidates, manifest, assumptions, loss and diagnostics.
